tools.name: Lovable
tools.short_description: Plain-English app builder that generates production-grade code with integrations and deployable output.
tools.supporting_snippet: "You describe what you want to build in plain English. Lovable converts that into fully functional, production-grade code with responsive design, Stripe payments, and authentication already wired in."

tools.name: Higgsfield
tools.short_description: Video creation toolkit with integrated AI models and editing features for ad generation.
tools.supporting_snippet: "You get Cinema Studio for granular camera controls, LipSync Studio for character animation, and a 4K upscaler on exports. Setup takes thirty seconds. First video in five minutes."

tools.name: Wispr Flow
tools.short_description: System-level voice dictation app that types clean text across any app.
tools.supporting_snippet: "It lives at the system level. That means it works inside every text field you already use, Gmail, Notion, Claude, Twitter, anywhere."

tools.name: Granola
tools.short_description: Meeting notes app that combines AI transcripts with manual notes for structured summaries.
tools.supporting_snippet: "it combines the AI transcript with your own manual notes from during the call. So instead of a wall of text you need to edit, you get a structured summary"

tools.name: OpenClaw
tools.short_description: Locally running autonomous AI agent with persistent memory, web browsing, and file/script actions.
tools.supporting_snippet: "OpenClaw runs entirely locally. No data leaves your machine. It connects to 50+ messaging platforms... It maintains persistent memory, runs bash scripts, handles file operations, and browses the web for you."

tools.name: Pomelli
tools.short_description: Brand-aware social content generator that creates platform-specific posts from a website URL.
tools.supporting_snippet: "You paste your website URL. Pomelli scans it, extracts your brand’s colour palette, fonts, tone, and messaging... then generates social content for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter"

tools.name: Gumloop
tools.short_description: Visual AI-native automation platform for multi-step workflows that include model calls, scraping, and data sources.
tools.supporting_snippet: "It uses a visual canvas where you connect AI models, web scrapers, data sources, and outputs into multi-step pipelines that can make decisions, not just pass data."
